topic: How a local bakery can get more Google reviews this week
title: Bakery Google Reviews: One Simple Tactic This Week
title_options: Get More Google Reviews for Your Bakery Fast
Easy Review Boost for Local Bakeries
description:
You run a bakery. Make leaving a Google review one tap for customers. This video shows a low-cost setup and exact scripts your staff can use.
No ads, no tricks. Small print cost and a same-day text follow-up. Use the QR card, train your team to ask, and send a short reminder. Follow for daily marketing fixes.

scenes.narration: Want more Google reviews this week?
One move: make leaving a review one tap. Put a QR review card at your register so customers leave reviews before they walk out.
[CHECK: You order 50 QR cards for about $8.] Put them on counters and tables where customers check out and near pastry displays.
You create the one-tap link from Google 'write a review'. Shorten it, put a clear button on receipts, and include it in same-day SMS.
Train staff to ask at checkout. Script to copy: 'Thanks! Tap the QR to leave a quick review. It helps us a lot.'
Next day, text: 'Loved baking for you—tap link to leave quick Google review.' Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
